projects.name: Enterprise Agentic Automation Platform
projects.description: A production-oriented agentic automation platform designed to orchestrate multi-step enterprise workflows using LLMs, tools, APIs and structured agent workflows.
keyContributions: Designed the agent orchestration and solution architecture.
Integrated enterprise APIs, tools and external systems.
Defined deployment, reliability and observability approaches.

projects.name: AI Document Processing Agent
projects.description: A proof-of-concept agentic workflow that processes business documents, extracts relevant information and coordinates downstream actions through tools and APIs.
keyContributions: Implemented document processing and information retrieval.
Connected the agent with external tools and APIs.

projects.name: Personal Profile & Learning Notebook
projects.description: A personal professional profile combined with a private 90-day learning notebook for tracking practical learning, implementation work, notes and progress.
keyContributions: Designed the application architecture and data model.
Developed the responsive profile and learning interfaces.
Designed the configurable learning and content structure.

projects.name: Agent Workflow Utilities
projects.description: A reusable collection of utilities and patterns for developing, testing and integrating agentic AI workflows with external tools and services.
keyContributions: Developed reusable components for agent workflows.
Created integration patterns for external tools.
